How it works

From first call to launch in four clear steps.

01

A 20-minute call to understand your goals.

02

Design and copy you approve before build.

03

Build, AI setup and testing on every device.

04

Launch, training, and ongoing care.

  1. STEP 01

    Strategy call

    We map your customers, your offer and the one action your site must drive. You get a clear proposal within 24 hours.

  2. STEP 02

    Design & copy

    A unique design system and conversion copy, shown as a clickable preview. Two rounds of revisions included.

  3. STEP 03

    Build & automate

    Fast, accessible code, AI assistant trained on your business, email follow-ups, analytics and security checks.

  4. STEP 04

    Launch & grow

    We go live, hand over everything you own, and keep improving it with a care plan if you want one.

FAQ

Questions, answered.

How long does a website take?+

Most sites launch in about three weeks once content is ready. Landing pages can go live in one week.

Do I own the website?+

Yes. Domain, hosting and code are in your name. I'm added as a user, so you're never locked in.

Will the AI assistant say wrong things?+

It answers only from the information you approve, hands off to you when unsure, and we test it before launch.

What does it cost to run each month?+

Hosting and AI usage usually cost [$X–$Y] per month for small businesses. You see the exact costs upfront.
